questions.text: Write the Preamble to the Constitution of our country.
questions.text_as_printed: Write the Preamble to the Constitution of our country. (Average)
solution_steps: "We, the People of India, having solemnly resolved to constitute India into a sovereign socialist secular democratic republic and to secure to all its citizens:
Justice: social, economic, and political;
Liberty: of thought, expression, belief, faith, and worship;
Equality: of status and opportunity;
and to promote among them all
Fraternity: assuring the dignity of the individual and the unity and integrity of the Nation;
In our Constituent Assembly, this 26th day of November 1949, do hereby adopt, enact, and give to ourselves this Constitution."

questions.text: Explain the salient features of our Constitution.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the salient features of our Constitution. (Difficult)

answer.value:
Main Features of Our Constitution
The Constitution of India is the longest written Constitution in the world.
The Constitution declares that India is a Republic. Since the country is governed by representatives elected by the people, it is a democratic republic.
The Constitution provides the citizens of India with six Fundamental Rights and 11 Fundamental Duties.
The Constitution upholds the principle of secularism. It states that the State should not discriminate on the basis of religion and should treat all religions equally.
Our Judiciary is independent and has sufficient powers. The Constitution states that neither the Legislature nor the Executive should interfere with the Judiciary.
Since caste-based discrimination is a social evil by birth, the objective of the Constitution is to eliminate it and establish social justice.
The ideal of the Constitution of India is to establish a Welfare State.
India is the largest democracy in the world, and the electoral system has been adopted.
